e.title: Insurance Pricing Pipeline Demo
e.summary: 保险定价管道演示（burning-cost，Colab 3 分钟）：CatBoost 频率模型→SHAP 费率表→FCA 代理歧视审计→漂移监测→conformal 区间
e.summary_en: Insurance pricing pipeline demo (burning-cost, Colab 3-min): CatBoost frequency → SHAP factor tables → FCA proxy discrimination audit → drift monitoring → conformal intervals
e.summary_hk: 保險定價管道演示（burning-cost，Colab 3 分鐘）：CatBoost 頻率模型→SHAP 費率表→FCA 代理歧視審計→漂移監測→conformal 區間
e.body: Insurance Pricing Pipeline Demo（burning-cost）是单 notebook 的端到端定价管道：同一合成 UK 车险数据集上运行 5 个库——CatBoost Poisson 频率模型、SHAP 提取精算因子表、FCA Consumer Duty 代理歧视审计、漂移监测、无分布 conformal 预测区间——Colab 免费 GPU 3 分钟内跑完。对 RIAA：定价管道的完整演示——[[insurance-pricing-course]]（12 模块课程）的浓缩版；「性别与地区相关但无因果路径」的合成数据设计（代理歧视审计教学）；与 [[shap-relativities]]（SHAP 相对数）、[[insurance-fairness]]（公平性）、[[insurance-conformal]]（区间）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移）配套；适合课程实验与教学演示。
e.body_en: The Insurance Pricing Pipeline Demo (burning-cost) is a single-notebook end-to-end pricing pipeline: running 5 libraries on the same synthetic UK motor dataset — CatBoost Poisson frequency model, SHAP-extracted actuarial factor tables, FCA Consumer Duty proxy discrimination audit, drift monitoring, distribution-free conformal prediction intervals — completing in under 3 minutes on free Colab GPU. For RIAA: a complete pricing pipeline demo — the condensed version of [[insurance-pricing-course]] (12-module course); the synthetic design (gender correlated with region but no causal path) teaches proxy discrimination auditing; pairs with [[shap-relativities]] (SHAP relativities), [[insurance-fairness]] (fairness), [[insurance-conformal]] (intervals) and [[insurance-monitoring]] (drift); suits coursework experiments and teaching demos.
e.body_hk: Insurance Pricing Pipeline Demo（burning-cost）是單 notebook 的端到端定價管道：同一合成 UK 車險數據集上運行 5 個庫——CatBoost Poisson 頻率模型、SHAP 提取精算因子表、FCA Consumer Duty 代理歧視審計、漂移監測、無分佈 conformal 預測區間——Colab 免費 GPU 3 分鐘內跑完。對 RIAA：定價管道的完整演示——[[insurance-pricing-course]]（12 模塊課程）的濃縮版；「性別與地區相關但無因果路徑」的合成數據設計（代理歧視審計教學）；與 [[shap-relativities]]（SHAP 相對數）、[[insurance-fairness]]（公平性）、[[insurance-conformal]]（區間）、[[insurance-monitoring]]（漂移）配套；適合課程實驗與教學演示。
